title: ACR Helper: a Google Meet™ add-on for a committee deciding on one applicant at a time
body: This video shows every user-facing feature end to end, on a spreadsheet of made-up applicants labeled TEST.
Scopes requested: openid, userinfo.email, userinfo.profile, and drive.file. Nothing else is read from Google, and no spreadsheet data is sent to any server.

kicker: 1 · Sign in inside Meet's side panel
title: Google's One Tap prompt, then Google's consent screen with every scope shown
body: openid, userinfo.email, userinfo.profile: sign the person in and show their name to the committee when they vote.
drive.file: see and change only the specific Google Drive files the person chooses for ACR Helper.

title: Google's file picker, pre-pointed at the committee's spreadsheet
body: The first time only, the person selects the committee's spreadsheet in the Google Picker (setFileIds). ACR Helper can then open that one file and nothing else in their Drive.
The picker lists the spreadsheet only if it is shared with the person, so the spreadsheet's own sharing decides who can use the add-on.

title: The panel opens the chosen spreadsheet with the person's own token
body: Start review reads the first row without a decision and shows that applicant on Meet's main stage.

title: Private votes, revealed together
body: Each member votes in their own panel; no one sees a choice until the chair presses Reveal.

title: The chair records the decision; a note is added
body: Record writes the committee's decision into that applicant's row, with a cell note naming who recorded it and when.
Add note appends a line to the row's Notes from Admissions cell. Nothing else is changed.

title: What ACR Helper wrote, in the one file it can open
body: The decision cell (Maybe = Waitlist) and its note, the appended line in Notes from Admissions, and a hidden tab holding the key that encrypts messages between members' add-ons.

title: One chosen file, the person's own permission, nothing kept elsewhere
list: openid, userinfo.email, userinfo.profile: sign-in, and the voter's name
drive.file: read the chosen spreadsheet; write the decision, a note, and the hidden key tab
No other file or Google data is opened
